identifierStrategy: String identifiers in MongoDB _id and all reference fields
timestampStrategy: BSON Date values with snake_case field names

collections.name: schema_versions
collections.purpose: Records the applied shared database contract.

collections.name: users
collections.purpose: Shared identity, authorization, stakeholder profile, and consent state.

collections.name: organizations
collections.purpose: Institutional stakeholders and their verification state.

collections.name: sessions
collections.purpose: Revocable server-side authentication sessions.

collections.name: consent_history
collections.purpose: Immutable history of operational privacy and research consent.

collections.name: facilities
collections.purpose: Approved collection, sorting, recycling, recovery, and upcycling locations.

collections.name: facility_assignments
collections.purpose: Authorizes a user to operate for a facility.

collections.name: collection_events
collections.purpose: Approved textile collection and community events.

collections.name: event_registrations
collections.purpose: User registrations and attendance state for collection events.

collections.name: material_batches
collections.purpose: Authoritative textile material identity, provenance, current state, and latest mass snapshot.

collections.name: measurements
collections.purpose: Immutable quantity history for each material-flow stage.

collections.name: listings
collections.purpose: Discoverability and availability record for a Material Batch.

collections.name: favorites
collections.purpose: Saved Material Listings for a user.

collections.name: match_requests
collections.purpose: Canonical user-proposed terms for receiving all or part of a listed Material Batch.

collections.name: transfers
collections.purpose: Authoritative material-transfer aggregate created from an accepted match request.

collections.name: flow_events
collections.purpose: Immutable chronological lifecycle events for a Material Batch and transfer.

collections.name: collection_receipts
collections.purpose: Permanent facility receipt connecting a source, transfer, batch, and measured quantity.

collections.name: recovery_records
collections.purpose: Facility processing input, output, rejection, documented loss, and circular outcome.

collections.name: conversations
collections.purpose: Transaction-party coordination without retail buyer/seller terminology.

collections.name: messages
collections.purpose: Messages exchanged by authorized conversation participants.

collections.name: notifications
collections.purpose: User notifications for approved system and participation events.

collections.name: reward_rules
collections.purpose: Versioned, disabled-by-default rules for approved non-cash incentives.

collections.name: reward_ledger
collections.purpose: Immutable non-cash point entries tied to validated activities.

collections.name: wallet_accounts
collections.purpose: Cached non-cash reward balance; reward_ledger remains authoritative.

collections.name: reports
collections.purpose: User-submitted content, transaction, or safety reports for administrative review.

collections.name: support_tickets
collections.purpose: Help, feedback, and approved UAT submissions.

collections.name: activity_logs
collections.purpose: Canonical immutable audit trail for sensitive and operational actions.

collections.name: configurations
collections.purpose: Versioned controlled vocabularies and approved operational parameters.

collections.name: data_quality_issues
collections.purpose: Persistent review workflow for validation and reconciliation findings.

collections.name: system_interactions
collections.purpose: Approved, privacy-scoped instrumentation for adoption and usability research.

collections.name: methodologies
collections.purpose: Approval registry for environmental, circularity, predictive, and decision-support methods.

collections.name: model_runs
collections.purpose: Non-production or approved analytical model executions with provenance.

collections.name: report_exports
collections.purpose: Audited report/export requests and their privacy scope.

legacyCollectionDecisions.offers: Deprecated in favor of match_requests; migrate listing-for-listing offers into explicit transfer terms.
legacyCollectionDecisions.transactions: Deprecated generic wallet transaction collection; use transfers for material movement and reward_ledger for points.
legacyCollectionDecisions.settings: Deprecated untyped key/value collection; use versioned configurations.
legacyCollectionDecisions.auditlogs: Deprecated duplicate audit source; use activity_logs.
legacyCollectionDecisions.products: Excluded from the BalikTela core material-first schema.
legacyCollectionDecisions.orders: Excluded because conventional retail checkout is outside the finalized blueprint.
legacyCollectionDecisions.inventorymovements: Excluded from core; material movement is represented by batches, measurements, transfers, and flow_events.
